name: Hamster-gurui no Kare wa Otosenai!!
original_name: ハムスター狂の彼は落とせない！！
source:
Kimitaka is a young man who loves hamsters a little too much.
No matter how close you get to him, all he talks about is hamsters. 
Can you win the heart of this hamster fanatic over on Valentine's Day? 
His feelings for his hamsters are stronger than love!? 

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/hamoto.html]official website[/url]]
